name: Kichi - Together Forever
source:
Just a game about your girlfriend trying her best to remind you of your life with her, the times you forgot and the memories the both of you built.

[From [url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/kichi-together-forever]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這只是一款關於你女朋友的遊戲。她正竭盡全力，想讓你記起和她在一起的生活、你忘卻的那些時光，還有你們兩人一同創造的回憶。

［取自[url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/kichi-together-forever]itch.io[/url]］
